answer: Each agent must present a hardware-rooted attestation from a sealed enclave whose endorsement key is bound to a scarce, staked identity, ensuring an opal-like unforgeable provenance that a sparrow-sized adversary cannot cheaply replicate. A fable of infinite free identities collapses because enclave quotes are rate-limited per physical root-of-trust, and zero-knowledge. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
